  SELECT 
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.height,
    AVG(pa.finishing) as avg_finishing
  FROM player p
  JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(p_sub.height) FROM player p_sub)
     OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(p_sub.height) FROM player p_sub)

)

FROM candidate_players cp
ORDER BY cp.avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;"}

{"sql": "WITH split_tags AS (
  SELECT TRIM(raw_tag) AS tag

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(posts.tags, ',') AS raw_tag

)

ORDER BY regexp_replace(split_tags.tag, '[<>]', '', 'g')"}

    frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) as rank
  FROM frpm

)
SELECT

  ranked_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(ranked_schools."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) as eligible_free_rate
FROM ranked_schools
WHERE ranked_schools.rank IN (10, 11)

{"sql": "WITH min_salary_district AS (
  SELECT district_id, a11
  FROM district
  WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM district)
)
, oldest_birth_in_min_salary AS (
  SELECT MIN(client.birth_date) as oldest_birth
  FROM client
  JOIN min_salary_district msd ON client.district_id = msd.district_id
  WHERE client.gender = 'F'
)
, selected_clients AS (
  SELECT client.client_id
  FROM client
  JOIN min_salary_district msd ON client.district_id = msd.district_id
  JOIN oldest_birth_in_min_salary obm ON client.birth_date = obm.oldest_birth
  WHERE client.gender = 'F'
)
, salary_gap_calc AS (
  SELECT (MAX(a11) - MIN(a11)) as gap
  FROM district
)
SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id, sgc.gap
FROM selected_clients sc
JOIN disp ON sc.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
CROSS JOIN salary_gap_calc sgc"}

{"sql": "WITH yearly_sums AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM loan.date) AS year,
    SUM(loan.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM client
  JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
  JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
  JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
  WHERE client.gender = 'M'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM loan.date) IN (1996, 1997)
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM loan.date)
)
SELECT
  (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1997 THEN total_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1996 THEN total_amount END)) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1996 THEN total_amount END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM yearly_sums;"}

{"sql": "WITH target_loan AS (
  SELECT loan.account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan.date = '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan.loan_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
  SELECT trans.balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE trans.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
    AND trans.date <= '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY trans.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
  SELECT trans.balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE trans.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
    AND trans.date <= '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY trans.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ((SELECT balance FROM balance_end) - (SELECT balance FROM balance_start)) /
  NULLIF((SELECT balance FROM balance_start), 0) * 100 as increase_rate"}
